cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, until a player planeswalks, you can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game.

cards.name: Cliffside Market
cards.text: When you planeswalk to Cliffside Market and at the beginning of your upkeep, you may exchange life totals with target player.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, exchange control of two target permanents that share a card type.

cards.name: Edge of Malacol
cards.text: If a creature you control would untap during your untap step, put two +1/+1 counters on it instead.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, untap each creature you control.

cards.name: Eloren Wilds
cards.text: Whenever a player taps a permanent for mana, that player adds one mana of any type that permanent produced.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target player can't cast spells until a player planeswalks.

cards.name: Feeding Grounds
cards.text:
Red spells cost {1} less to cast.
Green spells cost {1} less to cast.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, put X +1/+1 counters on target creature, where X is that creature's mana value.

cards.name: Fields of Summer
cards.text: Whenever a player casts a spell, that player may gain 2 life.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may gain 10 life.

cards.name: Furnace Layer
cards.text: When you planeswalk to Furnace Layer and at the beginning of your upkeep, select target player at random. That player discards a card. If that player discards a land card this way, they lose 3 life.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may destroy target nonland permanent.

cards.name: Glen Elendra
cards.text: At end of combat, you may exchange control of target creature you control that dealt combat damage to a player this combat and target creature that player controls.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, gain control of target creature you own.

cards.name: Goldmeadow
cards.text: Whenever a land enters, that land's controller creates three 0/1 white Goat creature tokens.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, create a 0/1 white Goat creature token.

cards.name: Grand Ossuary
cards.text: Whenever a creature dies, its controller distributes a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power among any number of target creatures they control.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, each player exiles all creatures they control and creates X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens, where X is the total power of the creatures they exiled this way. Then planeswalk.

cards.name: Grixis
cards.text: Blue, black, and/or red creature cards in your graveyard have unearth. The unearth cost is equal to the card's mana cost. (Pay the card's mana cost: Return it to the battlefield. The creature gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.

cards.name: Horizon Boughs
cards.text: All permanents untap during each player's untap step.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may search your library for up to three basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

cards.name: Immersturm
cards.text: Whenever a creature enters, that creature's controller may have it deal damage equal to its power to any target of their choice.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, exile target creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.

cards.name: Interplanar Tunnel
cards.ability: When you encounter Interplanar Tunnel, reveal cards from the top of your planar deck until you reveal five plane cards. Put a plane card from among them on top of your planar deck, then put the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom in a random order. (Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

cards.name: Izzet Steam Maze
cards.text: Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, that player copies it. The player may choose new targets for the copy.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn cost {3} less to cast.

cards.name: Kessig
cards.text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by non-Werewolf creatures.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, each creature you control gets +2/+2, gains trample, and becomes a Werewolf in addition to its other types until end of turn.

cards.name: Kilnspire District
cards.text: When you planeswalk to Kilnspire District and at the beginning of your first main phase, put a charge counter on Kilnspire District, then add {R} for each charge counter on it.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may pay {X}. If you do, Kilnspire District deals X damage to any target.

cards.name: Lair of the Ashen Idol
cards.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature. If you can't, planeswalk.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, any number of target players each create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: Lethe Lake
cards.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, mill ten cards.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target player mills ten cards.

cards.name: Llanowar
cards.text: All creatures have "{T}: Add {G}{G}."
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, untap all creatures you control.

cards.name: Minamo
cards.text: Whenever a player casts a spell, that player may draw a card.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, each player may return a blue card from their graveyard to their hand.

cards.name: Mirrored Depths
cards.text: Whenever a player casts a spell, that player flips a coin. If the player loses the flip, counter that spell.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a nonland card, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Morphic Tide
cards.ability: When you encounter Morphic Tide, each player shuffles all permanents they own into their library, then reveals that many cards from the top of their library. Each player puts all artifact, creature, land, and planeswalker cards revealed this way onto the battlefield, then does the same for enchantment cards, then puts all cards revealed this way that weren't put onto the battlefield on the bottom of their library in any order. (Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

cards.name: Mount Keralia
cards.text:
At the beginning of your end step, put a pressure counter on Mount Keralia.
When you planeswalk away from Mount Keralia, it deals damage equal to the number of pressure counters on it to each creature and each planeswalker.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, prevent all damage that planes named Mount Keralia would deal this game to permanents you control.

cards.name: Murasa
cards.text: Whenever a nontoken creature enters, its controller may search their library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target land becomes a 4/4 creature that's still a land.

cards.name: Naar Isle
cards.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a flame counter on Naar Isle, then Naar Isle deals damage to you equal to the number of flame counters on it.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, Naar Isle deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.

cards.name: Naya
cards.text: You may play any number of lands on each of your turns.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target red, green, or white creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each land you control.

cards.name: Nephalia
cards.text: At the beginning of your end step, mill seven cards. Then return a card at random from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, return target card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Norn's Dominion
cards.text: When you planeswalk away from Norn's Dominion, destroy each nonland permanent without a fate counter on it, then remove all fate counters from all permanents.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may put a fate counter on target permanent.

cards.name: Onakke Catacomb
cards.text: All creatures are black and have deathtouch.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain first strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Orzhova
cards.text: When you planeswalk away from Orzhova, each player returns all creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, for each opponent, exile up to one target creature card from that player's graveyard.

cards.name: Otaria
cards.text: Instant and sorcery cards in graveyards have flashback. The flashback cost is equal to the card's mana cost. (Its owner may cast the card from their graveyard for its mana cost. Then they exile it.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, take an extra turn after this one.

cards.name: Pools of Becoming
cards.text: At the beginning of your end step, put the cards in your hand on the bottom of your library in any order, then draw that many cards.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, reveal the top three cards of your planar deck. Each of the revealed cards' chaos abilities triggers. Then put the revealed cards on the bottom of your planar deck in any order.

cards.name: Prahv
cards.text:
If you cast a spell this turn, you can't attack with creatures.
If you attacked with creatures this turn, you can't cast spells.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you gain life equal to the number of cards in your hand.

cards.name: Quicksilver Sea
cards.text: When you planeswalk to Quicksilver Sea and at the beginning of your upkeep, scry 4. (Look at the top four cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, reveal the top card of your library. You may play it without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Raven's Run
cards.text: All creatures have wither. (They deal damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, put a -1/-1 counter on target creature, two -1/-1 counters on another target creature, and three -1/-1 counters on a third target creature.

cards.name: Sanctum of Serra
cards.text: When you planeswalk away from Sanctum of Serra, destroy all nonland permanents.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may have your life total become 20.

cards.name: Sea of Sand
cards.text:
Players reveal each card they draw.
Whenever a player draws a land card, that player gains 3 life.
Whenever a player draws a nonland card, that player loses 3 life.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, put target permanent on top of its owner's library.

cards.name: Shiv
cards.text: All creatures have "{R}: This creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn."
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.

cards.name: Skybreen
cards.text:
Players play with the top card of their libraries revealed.
Spells that share a card type with the top card of a library can't be cast.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target player loses life equal to the number of cards in their hand.

cards.name: Stairs to Infinity
cards.text:
Players have no maximum hand size.
Whenever you roll the planar die, draw a card.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, reveal the top card of your planar deck. You may put it on the bottom of your planar deck.

cards.name: Takenuma
cards.text: Whenever a creature leaves the battlefield, its controller draws a card.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, return target creature you control to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Talon Gates
cards.text: Any time you could cast a sorcery, you may exile a nonland card from your hand with X time counters on it, where X is its mana value. If the exiled card doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend. (At the beginning of its owner's upkeep, they remove a time counter. When the last is removed, the player may cast it without paying its mana cost. If it's a creature, it has haste.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, remove two time counters from each suspended card you own.

cards.name: Tazeem
cards.text: Creatures can't block.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, draw a card for each land you control.

cards.name: Tember City
cards.text: Whenever a player taps a land for mana, Tember City deals 1 damage to that player.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, each other player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice.

cards.name: The Dark Barony
cards.text: Whenever a nonblack card is put into a player's graveyard from anywhere, that player loses 1 life.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, each opponent discards a card.

cards.name: The Eon Fog
cards.text: Players skip their untap steps.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, untap all permanents you control.

cards.name: The Fourth Sphere
cards.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a nonblack creature.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

cards.name: The Hippodrome
cards.text: All creatures get -5/-0.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may destroy target creature if its power is 0 or less.

cards.name: The Maelstrom
cards.text: When you planeswalk to The Maelstrom and at the beginning of your upkeep, you may reveal the top card of your library. If a permanent card is revealed this way, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you revealed a card but didn't put it onto the battlefield, put it on the bottom of your library.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, return target permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: The Zephyr Maze
cards.text:
Creatures with flying get +2/+0.
Creatures without flying get -2/-0.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target creature gains flying until end of turn.

cards.name: Time Distortion
cards.ability: When you encounter Time Distortion, reverse the game's turn order. (For example, if play had proceeded clockwise around the table, it now goes counterclockwise. Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

cards.name: Trail of the Mage-Rings
cards.text: Instant and sorcery spells have rebound. (The spell's controller exiles the spell as it resolves if they cast it from their hand. At the beginning of that player's next upkeep, they may cast that card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Velis Vel
cards.text: Each creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature on the battlefield that shares at least one creature type with it. (For example, if two Elemental Shamans and an Elemental Spirit are on the battlefield, each gets +2/+2.)
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, target creature gains all creature types until end of turn.

cards.name: Windriddle Palaces
cards.text:
Players play with the top card of their libraries revealed.
You may play lands and cast spells from the top of any player's library.
cards.ability: Whenever chaos ensues, each player mills a card.
